title: Testing selection on observables in parametric models with refreshment samples
abstract: arXiv:2608.23508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In panels with sample selection (that may occur due to attrition, nonresponse, etc.), the assumption of selection on observables (missing at random, MAR) is commonly imposed despite often being implausible. However, this assumption becomes testable when a refreshment sample is available. We develop a statistical test of MAR based on a distance between two estimated distributions: one obtained using the standard inverse probability weighting (IPW) that is valid under MAR and the other obtained using an alternative weighting that is valid under a weaker assumption of additive nonignorability of Hirano et al. (2001). This test implicitly compares the distribution of the IPW-weighted sample in the attrition period with the distribution of the refreshment sample, which coincide if the MAR assumption holds. We establish that, when the input distributions are parametric, our test statistic converges to the generalized chi-squared distribution u

translated_title: 在含刷新样本的参数模型中检验基于可观测变量的选择机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23508v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在存在样本选择（可能由损耗、无响应等原因导致）的面板数据中，通常假设基于可观测变量的选择机制（随机缺失，MAR），尽管这一假设往往并不合理。然而，当有刷新样本可用时，这一假设变得可检验。我们开发了一种基于两个估计分布之间距离的MAR统计检验：一个分布通过标准逆概率加权（IPW）获得，该加权在MAR下有效；另一个分布通过替代加权获得，该加权在Hirano等人（2001年）提出的较弱假设——加性不可忽略性下有效。该检验隐含地比较了损耗期内IPW加权样本的分布与刷新样本的分布，若MAR假设成立，两者应一致。我们证明，当输入分布为参数形式时，我们的检验统计量收敛于广义卡方分布。
tldr: 本文提出一种利用刷新样本检验面板数据中随机缺失（MAR）假设的统计方法，通过比较逆概率加权与替代加权所得分布的差异，并证明其统计量在参数模型下服从广义卡方分布。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a statistical test for the missing-at-random (MAR) assumption in panel data using refreshment samples, comparing inverse probability weighting with alternative weighting distributions, and shows the test statistic follows a generalized chi-squared distribution under parametric models.
